currentParagraphText: “Do try to be more mindful,” Hank said in a slightly scolding tone, the construction manager being one of the few “normal” people in Haven who still spoke to Jake like a normal person. “This time, you got lucky, but what if the angle had been bad? You could have hit the city, and I hope I don’t need to tell you why that could have been bad.”
